utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over my tool kit for the repair drive. Just let me know what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Let’s start with the first locations, and I’ll keep the list in order so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Uli — I can help spread the word and collect a few donations for the repair drive. What still needs to be gathered?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly nails, tarps, tape, and a few working tools. I can give a little too, but I need to keep it modest right now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and get you the details too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll send the repair drive details again so you have the latest info to share.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: We’re collecting small appliance parts, tools, and any broken gear people want fixed up. If you’ve got something, just drop it by and I’ll sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what part of the repair drive needs the most help right now?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, thanks, Noah — even a little tape or a sturdy box would help a lot. If you find anything, just bring it by and we’ll put it to use right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll see if I’ve got some tape or a box lying around and bring it by. Sorry, I’ve been a bit scattered today.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Kira — I’ll send over the locations I have for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — just to confirm, we’re starting with the leaky sink and the front door hinge, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and we need the most help sorting tools and greeting folks at check-in. If you can lend a hand there, that would be wonderful.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I can help sort tools and greet folks at check-in on Sunday at the community center. I’ll pass that along to others too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Tell me what the repair drive needs most, and I’ll check what we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Start with the leaky sink and the front door hinge—they’re the most urgent. I’m still making the list of what else the repair drive needs.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, thanks — the repair drive needs nails, tarps, tape, and a few working tools first. If you can check those, I’ll sort the rest of the list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ve noted nails, tarps, tape, and a few working tools for the repair drive. Send any other locations or items, and I’ll keep tracking them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details again, just so I make sure I have everything right?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — what’s the repair drive short on most right now?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks Rey — send them when you can and I’ll keep everything moving on my side.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep — I’ll send the list over and confirm the volunteers and tools today.
